summary: Controller sends JSON logs over HTTP to external aggregators: job facts, job events, activity stream and log messages. Its bundled rsyslog lacks udpspoof and libdbi; use only that package, or run a separate rsyslog process with its own config for system logs. /api/v2/settings/logging/ configures queuing when the aggregator is offline.
questions: Can I use the RHEL rsyslog package with automation controller?
What data can controller send to a log aggregator?
How do I keep using rsyslog for system logs on controller nodes?
